title: anthropics/prompt-eng-interactive-tutorial: practise clearer instructions for Claude
friendlyTitle: Anthropic’s free course teaches better prompts through practice
summary: Anthropic’s interactive prompt-engineering course has returned to GitHub’s trending list, with more than 37,000 stars. Its nine chapters and exercises cover clear instructions, examples, output formats, hallucination reduction, tool use and retrieval.
friendlySummary: The course has nine lessons and exercises about clear instructions, examples, output formats, mistakes, tools and search.
whyItMatters: Work through the exercises to build a repeatable habit of specifying goals, separating instructions from data and testing outputs. Some examples reference older Claude models, but the core practices remain useful across modern assistants.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it to practise giving AI clearer tasks and checking the results. Some model names are old, but the main lessons still help.
